North Korea displayed over 30 new military assets, including suicide drones, at its first solo exhibition.
Four oil tankers struck mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian reports.
The US approved a potential $2.1 billion sale of Patriot missiles to Ukraine.
Houthi missile and drone attacks targeted Aden airport and the presidential palace, leading to government calls for international action.
Jordanian authorities arrested suspects in connection with a deadly attack.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted Houthi ballistic missiles and drones targeting Riyadh and other regions.

A drone attack caused significant damage to an industrial facility in Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region.
Iranian forces claimed to have destroyed a US-made drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
A Russian drone strike on the Dnipro train station killed 14 people.
Witnesses report that drone strikes in Ethiopia killed at least 25 people.
Russian attacks across multiple regions left hundreds of thousands of Ukrainian households without electricity.
U.S. Air Force aerial refueling tankers were observed parked at Ramon International Airport.
Drone strikes and accusations by Sudan regarding attacks originating from neighboring territory, resulting in reported casualties.
Water supply was restored in Kyiv following a Russian strike on an infrastructure facility.
Ethiopia took delivery of 12 Su-35 fighter jets and is set to receive S-400 air defense systems, PM Abiy announced.
Ukrainian strikes hit a missile fuel plant and air defense assets, including an S-400 system and Pantsir-S2, in Russia's Rostov region, causing an estimated $70 million in damage.
Ukrainian drones struck the Ufa refinery, causing a fire.
Russian strikes and missile attacks hit infrastructure and energy facilities in Dnipro and surrounding regions, causing power outages and injuries.
Houthi-aligned media published footage claiming the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targeted two oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, causing fires.
Russian attacks on the Sumy region killed one person and injured 12 others.
A Russian attack on Vinnytsia Oblast killed a man and a woman and injured three children.
Saudi-led coalition forces carried out airstrikes in Yemen, leaving civilian casualties.
A drone strike in Ethiopia's Tigray region killed 12 civilians who were collecting grain.
Venezuelan forces bombed a guerrilla camp near the Colombian border.
A Houthi missile strike killed at least 53 people at a Yemeni military camp.
New fighting in Yemen has displaced 290,000 people, according to the UN.
Sudan stated that drone attacks originating from Ethiopia killed and wounded hundreds of people.
Heavy frontline clashes continued along the front line, with the fiercest fighting in the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka sectors.

Ukrainian deep strikes in October destroyed 11 Russian aircraft, two Mi-8 helicopters, oil refineries, and defense facilities.
A Russian airstrike struck Kramatorsk, destroying a notable building.
Russia attacked Ukraine with 433 drones, of which 371 were shot down or suppressed by Ukrainian air defenses.
The Russian Ministry of Defence claimed air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 235 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
Ukrainian air defense downed 122 out of 168 Russian attack drones over the past day, with 30 still airborne.
A Ukrainian strike disabled all primary oil refining units at the Novokuybyshevsky Oil Refinery.
Russia reported shooting down 433 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
Experts blame an elite North Korean group for a $6.3bn hack on Binance, leading to suspended trades.
